raw_record.summary: A Yahoo Finance (yfinance) powered financial analysis tool. Get real-time quotes, generate high-resolution charts with moving averages + indicators (RSI/MACD/Bollinger/VWAP/ATR), summarize fundamentals, and run a one-shot report that outputs both a text summary and a Pro chart.
